title: API availability by Plan
snippet:
Our Public API is available on all [ClickUp Plans](https://clickup.com/pricing) . Some endpoints and parameters are limited by plan.
#
Endpoints available on the Enterprise Plan
The following endpoints are only available on the Enterprise Plan:
**Manage users**
- [Invite User To Workspace](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/inviteusertoworkspace)
- [Get User](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/getuser)
- [Edit User On Workspace](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/edituseronworkspace)
- [Remove User From Workspace](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/removeuserfromworkspace)
**Manage guests**
- [Invite Guest To Workspace](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/inviteguesttoworkspace)
- [Get Guest](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/getguest)
- [Edit Guest On Workspace](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/editguestonworkspace)
- [Remove Guest From Workspace](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/removeguestfromworkspace)
- [Add Guest To Task](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/addguesttotask)
- [Remove Guest From Task](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/removeguestfromtask)
- [Add Guest To List](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/addguesttolist)
- [Remove Guest From List](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/removeguestfromlist)
- [Add Guest To Folder](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/addguesttofolder)
- [Remove Guest From Folder](https://developer.clickup.com/reference-link/removeguestfromfolder)

title: Create your own app with the ClickUp API
snippet:
# What you'll need
- The ClickUp API is available on all [ClickUp plans](https://clickup.com/pricing).
- Workspace owners or admins can manage integration settings and create OAuth apps in the Workspace.
- Members and limited members with full edit permissions can use personal API tokens.
- Limited members with view-only permissions cannot access or manage the API.

title: How to Use the ClickUp MCP Server: Setup, Tools, and Real Examples
snippet:
| At a glance | What to know |
|---|---|
| **Best for** | AI-assisted workflows that read, act on, and connect work across your ClickUp Workspace |
| **Official endpoint** | `https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp` |
| **Authentication** | OAuth; API keys and personal access tokens aren’t supported |
| **Works with** | Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, and other supported MCP clients |
| **Can access** | Tasks, Docs, comments, Chat, time tracking, Workspace hierarchy, reporting, and more |
| **Use the ClickUp API when** | You need deterministic logic, webhooks, scheduled jobs, or higher-volume integrations |
| **Watch for** | Workspace permissions, shared MCP limits, and AI Search boundaries |
|

Two things to know up front. The server works on every ClickUp plan, Free Forever included. And whatever an AI client does through the MCP stays within your account’s existing permissions.

You need four things, and none of them requires you to build an integration.
- **Any ClickUp plan works.** ClickUp MCP is available on all plans, including Free Forever
- **An MCP-compatible client.** ClickUp maintains an allowlist of vetted MCP clients, including Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Devin, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Antigravity, Make, and Workato
- **The server URL:** [https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp](https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp)
- **A ClickUp account you can authorize through OAuth.** API keys and personal access tokens aren’t supported

ClickUp only supports OAuth for MCP authentication. Personal API keys and access tokens won’t work, and that’s intentional.
**OAuth ties every action to the user who authorized it and scopes access to the Workspaces they selected,** which makes permissions easier to audit and revoke than a static key would be. If you’re building a custom MCP client, it needs to implement OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP, and the full MCP specification.
**Worth Knowing:** A study of 7,973 live remote MCP servers found that [40.55 percent had no authentication at all](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22333). ClickUp’s OAuth-only approach means your connection never falls into that bucket: access is tied to your account, scoped to the Workspaces you picked, and revocable any time.

ClickUp MCP rate limits depend on two things: [your Workspace plan](https://clickup.com/pricing) and whether your Workspace has the Everything AI add-on.
With Everything AI, MCP requests use the same per-minute, per-token limits as ClickUp’s public AP
